吗.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 马 represents the sound.
x: 你喜欢吗？
Nǐ xǐhuān ma?
Do you like it?
你爸爸好吗？你妈妈呢？
Nǐ bàba hǎo ma? Nǐ māma ne?
How is your father? And your mom?

c.h: 彳 is a component form of 行.

得.o: Depicts a hand (寸) grabbing a shell (貝), used as currency in ancient China, to convey the meaning "get". Originally written as 㝵. The 彳 (movement) component was added later.
w: structural particle: used after a verb (or adjective as main…
to get; to obtain; to receive
to obtain; to receive; to get
to acquire; to get; to obtain
have no choice or option but to; cannot but
x: 他得了个坏名声。
Tā dé le ge huài míngshēng.
He gained a bad reputation.
如何让一个男生觉得你很特别？
Rúhé ràng yīge nánshēng juéde nǐ hěn tèbié?
How can you make a boy think you're special?
问题得到了解决。
Wèntí dédào le jiějué.
The problem has been solved.

c.h: 爫 is a component form of 爪.

受.o: Depicts a boat (舟) being passed from one hand (爫) to another hand (又). 舟 also served as phonetic, but it was later abbreviated.
w: to receive (praise, an education, punishment etc)
to enjoy; to live it up; pleasure
casualty; victim; those injured and wounded
to bear; to support; to inherit
x: 这使得他很受朋友欢迎。
Zhè shǐdé tā hěn shòu péngyǒu huānyíng.
This makes him very popular with his friends.
不用道歉，我不会接受。
Bùyòng dàoqiàn, wǒ bùhuì jiēshòu.
Don’t apologize. I won’t accept it.
中央政府的权威受到削弱。
Zhōngyāng zhèngfǔ de quánwēi shòudào xuēruò.
The authority of the central government has been weakened.
co: to take into account others' feelings
yī wèi shǒubì shòushāng de nǚshēng
a girl with an injured arm

c.h: ⺮ is a component form of 竹.

算.o: Depicts a tool (具) made from bamboo (⺮) for performing calculations, such as an abacus.
w: to plan; to intend; to calculate
to count; to calculate; to compute
let it be; let it pass; forget about it
x: 我打算卖他一次人情。
Wǒ dǎsuàn mài tā yīcì rénqíng.
I plan to do him a favour.
这人算是丢脸到家了。
Zhè rén suànshì diūliǎn dàojiā le.
They have lost face completely.
天气预报里雪的厚度是怎么计算的？
Tiānqì yùbào lǐ xuě de hòudù shì zěnme jìsuàn de?
How is the thickness of snow calculated in weather forecasts?

南.o: Depicts a bell-shaped musical instrument. The current meaning of 南 is a phonetic loan.
w: south; the southern part of the country
north and south; north to south
x: 圣特罗佩是一个位于法国南方的富人小镇。
Shèngtèluópèi shì yīge wèiyú Fǎguó nánfāng de fùrén xiǎozhèn.
St Tropez is a wealthy town in the south of France.
他是南方人，所以一张口说话就带有南方口音。
Tā shì nánfāngrén, suǒyǐ yī zhāngkǒu shuōhuà jiù dàiyǒu nánfāng kǒuyīn.
He is from the South, so when he opens his mouth to speak, you can hear his Southern accent.
co: (Taiwan) to debate between customs in the north and the south

北.o: Pictograph of two people standing back-to-back. Based on the original meaning "back", now written as 背. The current meaning "north" is a phonetic loan.
w: north; the northern part a country
the North Pole; the Arctic Pole
x: 东北人都是活雷锋。
Dōngběirén dōu shì huó Léi Fēng.
All people from Northeast China are living Lei Fengs. [humorous]
我觉得东北话实在太土了。
Wǒ juéde dōngběihuà shízài tài tǔ le.
I think that Northeastern Mandarin is too rustic.

字.o: Phonosemantic compound. 宀 represents the meaning and 子 represents the sound. The 宀 (roof) component is based on the original meaning "raise up children". The meaning later shifted to "educate", "word", and "writing".
w: cross; crucifix; yoke one has to endure
x: 这个字怎么念？
Zhège zì zěnme niàn?
How do you read this character?
你叫什么名字？
Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
What's your name?
他的字很差。
Tā de zì hěn chà.
His handwriting is very bad.
co: One's handwriting is like the one themself
to come up with a name

x: 请爱护森林。
Qǐng àihù sēnlín.
Please protect our trees.
我有一个住在什未林的朋友。
Wǒ yǒu yī ge zhù zài Shíwèilín de péngyǒu.
I have a friend who lives in Schwerin.
co: to attach importance to forest conservation

c.h: Shorthand for the 隹 component in the traditional character 羅.

罗.o: Simplified form of 羅. Depicts a net (网) for catching birds (隹).
x: 加里宁格勒州是俄罗斯的一块飞地。
Jiālǐnínggélè Zhōu shì Éluósī de yī kuài fēidì.
Kaliningrad Oblast is an exclave of Russia.
美国北佛罗里达大学宣布关闭孔子学院。
Měiguó Běi Fóluólǐdá Dàxué xuānbù guānbì Kǒngzǐ Xuéyuàn.
The University of North Florida, United States, announces the closure of the Confucius Institute.

託.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 乇 represents the sound.

c.h: 犭 is a component form of 犬.

狗.o: Phonosemantic compound. 犭 represents the meaning and 句 represents the sound.
x: 小狗摇着尾巴跑了。
Xiǎo gǒu yáo zhe wěiba pǎo le.
The little dog ran off wagging its tail.
小狗摇著尾巴跑了。
Xiǎo gǒu yáo zhe wěiba pǎo le.
The little dog ran off wagging its tail.

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

列.o: Depicts breaking apart bones (歹) using a knife (刂). 歹 also represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "break apart". The meaning later shifted to "arrange in order" and "list".
w: a line; to arrange in order, classify
a series of; a string of
x: 帝国主义列强强加给中国一系列不平等条约。
Dìguózhǔyì lièqiáng qiángjiā gěi Zhōngguó yī xìliè bù píngděng tiáoyuē.
The imperialist powers forced a series of unequal treaties upon China.
列车正在加速。
Lièchē zhèngzài jiāsù.
The train is speeding up.
co: to result in a series of problems
to list as a world cultural heritage site

众.o: Triple of 人 (person), depicts many people together. Simplified form of 眾.
w: the masses; the great bulk of the population
to stand out from the masses (idiom)
x: 这位贵妇穿著打扮的品味，与众不同。
Zhèwèi guìfù chuānzhù dǎbàn de pǐnwèi, yǔzhòngbùtóng.
This lady's taste in clothing and style is quite unique.
枪炮声使群众惊慌失措。
Qiāngpào shēng shǐ qúnzhòng jīnghuāngshīcuò.
The crowd panicked at the sound of the guns.
co: 展现出与众不同的魅力

驗.o: Phonosemantic compound. 馬 represents the meaning and 僉 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "type of horse". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

c.h: Originally the sound component was 之/止, but was later reanalyzed as 士, which also works as a sound component.

志.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 士 represents the sound. In simplified Chinese 志 is also used to mean "write down, record", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 誌.
x: 我边等边浏览几本杂志。
Wǒ biān děng biān liúlǎn jǐ běn zázhì.
I browsed through some magazines while I waited.

Àifēi'ěr Tiětǎ shì Bālí de biāozhìxìng jiànzhù.
The Eiffel Tower is Paris's landmark structure.

斗.o: Pictograph of a ladle or dipper. In simplified Chinese 斗 is also used to mean "fight, struggle", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 鬥.
w: to fight; to engage in combat; struggle
to duel; a duel; decisive struggle
to wrestle; to fight; to struggle
x: 我会战斗到最后一口气。
Wǒ huì zhàndòu dào zuìhòu yī kǒu qì.
I will fight to my last breath.
准备着：为共产主义事业而奋斗！
Zhǔnbèi zhe: wèi gòngchǎn zhǔyì shìyè ér fèndòu!
To fight for the cause of communism: Be ready! (motto of the Young Pioneers of China)

块.o: Simplified form of 塊. Phonosemantic compound. 土 represents the meaning and 夬 represents the sound.
w: one block; one piece; one (unit of money)
x: 你给三块，就可以了。
Nǐ gěi sān kuài, jiù kěyǐ le.
If you give 3 yuan, it'll be enough.
我们想到一块了。
Wǒmen xiǎng dào yīkuài le.
We had the same thought.
把肉切成小块。
Bǎ ròu qièchéng xiǎo kuài.
Cut the meat into bite-sized pieces.

店.o: Phonosemantic compound. 广 represents the meaning and 占 represents the sound.

Zhè ge shāngdiàn yǒu xiāngdāng yī pī píxié xiànhuò.

Yǒuxiē dìqū de fàndiàn fúwù rényuán tàidù èliè.
The hotel service people in some regions have a poor attitude.

c.h: Depicts two beautiful antlers on the head of a deer.

A large amount of property was stolen.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

shìsú hé zōngjiào zhījiān de guānxì

颗.o: Phonosemantic compound. 果 represents the meaning and 页 represents the sound. Simplified form of 顆.

Kēlì bǎomǎn.
The grains are full and plump.
这颗钻的净度不错。
Zhè kē zuàn de jìngdù bù cuò.
The clarity of this diamond is pretty good.

旗.o: Phonosemantic compound. 㫃 represents the meaning and 其 represents the sound.
